checks.ref: command:if grep -rn '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' openspec/changes --include=tasks.md --exclude-dir=archive; then echo "the tasks listed above are still open - do them, then tick them in tasks.md"; exit 1; fi

command:base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main); oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/ and the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no new dependency - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

findings.message: packages/client/src/model/reduceSelectInstant.ts:29 accepts instants that are not ISO 8601 with Z: it only calls Temporal.Instant.from, which also accepts offsets such as "2026-03-08T07:30:00+05:00". specs/time-selection/spec.md says: "a selection whose instant is malformed (not ISO 8601 with `Z`) MUST be rejected as an invalid instant and MUST change nothing", and CLAUDE.md requires "ISO 8601 with Z suffix". Reject any string that does not end in Z with LocationErrorCode.INVALID_INSTANT, and add a test with an offset instant to model/reduceSelectInstant.test.ts.

Traceability is missing on changed production code. tasks.md requires "`Implements FR-X of add-time-sliders-to-location-cards` in the JSDoc of new or changed production code". controller/useLocations.ts now passes referenceDay to the presenter (design D6, FR1/FR2), but its JSDoc has no line for this change.

Traceability is missing in views/cards/CardsView.tsx: it now takes selectTrackFraction/moveTrack from useTimeSelection() and passes them to LocationList (design D8, FR3/FR4), but its JSDoc does not name add-time-sliders-to-location-cards.

Traceability is missing in views/shared/LocationList.tsx: it gained the onSelectTrackFraction/onMoveTrack props and passes them to LocationRow (design D8), but has no 'Implements ... of add-time-sliders-to-location-cards' JSDoc line.

controller/useLocations.ts:40,43 calls clock.instant() twice, once for the effective instant and once for getReferenceDay. If the reference zone's midnight falls between the two reads, the presented fraction is worked out against the wrong day (negative or above 1). The spec says "While the moment is live the handle MUST follow the clock ... when the day changes at midnight of the reference zone the track moves to the new day". Read the clock once and use that instant for both.

model/dayPeriodStops.ts:56-75: getDayPeriodStops takes a `schedule` parameter, but its cache is keyed only by day (cachedDayKey) and zone (cachedStopsByZone). A call with a non-default schedule after a default one (or the reverse) returns the other schedule's stops. Add the schedule to the cache key, or drop the parameter and pass custom schedules only to the uncached collect/assemble functions.
